ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this content block. Used as an accessible label for the marquee section.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

Items.helper: Add as many marquee items as needed. Items display in the order shown here.

ItemLabel.helper: Editor-only label shown in the Marquee Items accordion header.

ItemType.helper: Choose whether this marquee item renders as text with an optional icon or as a standalone logo image.

IconClass.helper: Optional icon class if the active theme supports icon fonts. Example: fas fa-bolt.

LogoImage.helper: Logo image for this item. Use SVG or transparent PNG when possible.

WithLink.helper: Enable this when the item should link to another page or external URL.

LinkTarget.helper: Choose whether the optional link opens in the current browser tab or a new browser tab.

AriaLabel.helper: Optional accessible label. Useful when an item is only a logo or when link text needs extra context.
